title: MPS calculator: approve the words for feedback triage and 'My feedback' (MPSCALC-176)
bluf: Tap a to approve the word pack for feedback triage and 'My feedback' as written. Administrators get four statuses (Open, In progress, Done, Dismissed), two priorities (Normal, High) and a Notes box; each sender gets a 'My feedback' tab showing their own items and status only. 24 rows of new words (some repeat the four status words) and 20 rows reusing the app's existing feedback words; no email. The full pack is attached to my message beside this card. Nothing is built until you approve.

options.label: Approve the pack as written (recommended)
options.detail: The words are cleared for the MPSCALC-176 build. Defaults stand: senders do not see Administrator notes or priority; two priority levels; 'My feedback' is a third tab in the Feedback dialog for every signed-in person.

options.label: Approve, with my answers to the three open questions
options.detail: Reply with answers to: (1) do senders see notes and priority (default no); (2) priority levels (default two: Normal, High; alternative three: Low, Medium, High); (3) where 'My feedback' lives (default a third tab for everyone, whatever the roles ruling becomes). Words that change with your answers are re-drafted and re-checked before any build.

options.label: Hold for my review
options.detail: Nothing is built and the pack stays a draft until you have read it and reply.

default_action: Nothing is built until you approve.
_override_prior: Kam ruled a ('Draft the word pack now') at 11:52 today on the triage-words card; this is the pack that ruling asked for. Other matches share only generic words (project prefix, date, words, feedback).
